parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

*   zh: Chinese
*   en: English

parameters.name: EnableWaf
parameters.description: Specifies whether to activate Web Application Firewall (WAF).

parameters.name: GatewayUniqueId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the gateway.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun mse update-gateway-route-waf-status --route-id 645 --gateway-unique-id gw-86575c0bc9f04ecfbacb92b8e3920000 --accept-language zh --enable-waf true --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun mse UpdateGatewayRouteWafStatus --region cn-hangzhou --GatewayUniqueId 'gw-86575c0bc9f04ecfbacb92b8e3920000' --EnableWaf true --AcceptLanguage zh --RouteId 645
